notes.title: Silly adventure game Marron's Day coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello! I just launched the Steam page for my new game, Marron's Day! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42184151/1f85862df610561c7cf21479e11566b460dcaadd.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42184151/60a209afb154364d2b00a8dfef1588cf64319573.gif[/img] 

Marron's Day is a silly adventure game where you're a bunny! You love your friends but love carrots even more. Explore the town, run errands for your animal friends, and don't let anyone catch you swiping the carrots from the garden (again)! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2620590/Marrons_Day/

Explore town, help your friends... and steal carrots?

Wishlist this retro bunny adventure now! If you liked this game by me, I think you might like Marron's Day too 🐰 It has a cute and relaxing story with unique characters.

notes.title: A Year Of Springs dev npckc is bringing their fantasy tea-brewing sim to PC
notes.notes:
If you’re a fan of visual novels, you’ve likely come across developer npckc for their work on A Pet Shop After Dark and A Year Of Springs - one of the best visual novels on PC. They’re now bringing Tavern For Tea - a lovely-looking tea-brewing sim - to PC, after it launched on mobile a few years ago.

Read more

notes.title: A TAVERN FOR TEA is coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Fantasy tea-brewing adventure [b]A TAVERN FOR TEA[/b] is coming to Steam on March 24th! Listen to your customers' worries and brew them the tea that they didn't know they needed. 

The game was originally made for a game jam in 2019 and this Steam version is an expanded version of that with updated 1080p graphics, a new in-game gallery, an extra after-hours teatime mode, and more translations!

Brew tea, chat with customers, and make connections.

Wishlist the game now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2319470/A_TAVERN_FOR_TEA/
